<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Read the input CSV
    input_file = "outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv"
    df = pd.read_csv(input_file)
    
    # Get column names in order
    columns = df.columns.tolist()
    
    # Calculate missingness per indicator
    for col in columns:
        # Count missing values
        missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
        # Calculate missing rate
        missing_rate = missing_count / len(df)
        # Keep track of kept status (whether to keep this indicator)
        df.loc[:, f'missing_rate_{col}'] = missing_rate
        
    # Create missingness report
    report = []
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        indicator = row['indicator']
        missing_count = row['missing_count']
        missing_rate = row['missing_rate']
        kept = 'Yes' if missing_rate <= 0.30 else 'No'
        report.append({
            'indicator': indicator,
            'missing_count': missing_count,
            'missing_rate': missing_rate,
            'kept': kept
        })
    
    # Save missingness report
    report_path = "outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv"
    pd.DataFrame(report).to_csv(report_path, index=False)
    
    # Create selected matrix
    selected_cols = []
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        indicator = row['indicator']
        missing_rate = row['missing_rate']
        if missing_rate <= 0.30:
            selected_cols.append(indicator)
    
    # Prepare selected data
    selected_data = []
    for idx, row in df.iterrows():
        indicator = row['indicator']
        missing_rate = row['missing_rate']
        if missing_rate <= 0.30:
            selected_data.append({
                'city_id': row['city_id'],
                'city_name': row['city_name'],
                'year': row['year'],
                'indicator': indicator
            })
    
    # Save selected matrix
    selected_path = "outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv"
    selected_df = pd.DataFrame(selected_data)
    selected_df.to_csv(selected_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
</solution_file>
